ui.note: NDTI is a relative index: comparable only within one sub-reach, never NTU. An anomaly is a departure from the sub-reach's own baseline, never evidence that any actor caused anything.

sources.title: sinu-urra-01
sources.text: Higher discharges to the Sinú announced after rain in the upper basin (28 Nov 2022: reservoir inflow 777.7 m3/s, turbine discharge 486.3 m3/s); by 30 Nov 2022 the reservoir was reported overflowing through the spillway and an orange alert was declared in Córdoba.

sources.title: sinu-urra-02
sources.text: An orange operational alert was declared on 12 Jul 2025 for a possible overflow of the Urrá I reservoir (downgraded on 22 Jul 2025). On 13 Jul 2025 the reservoir was reported at 129.9 m a.s.l., 0.6 m below the 130.5 m a.s.l. overflow level (Infobae only, which calls the alert red).

sources.title: sinu-urra-03
sources.text: Gradual reduction of generation announced, with 3 of 4 units running from Saturday 2 Aug 2025, to keep reservoir volume for flood control and lower downstream river levels (lower turbine discharge).

sources.title: sinu-urra-04
sources.text: A bulletin reported the Urrá I reservoir above 130.00 m a.s.l., with inflows above turbine capacity and a possible overflow through the spillway; an orange alert was declared in eight municipalities along the Sinú. The operator also reported running all four generating units from 30 Nov 2025 (higher controlled discharges into the Sinú).

sources.title: sinu-urra-05
sources.text: A flood in the upper Sinú basin pushed inflows to the Urrá I reservoir to about 2,300 m3/s early on 14 Aug 2022, with the reservoir level reported about 20 cm below the overflow threshold; red flood alerts were reported in the lower Sinú (Lorica, San Bernardo del Viento).

sources.title: sinu-urra-06
sources.text: After heavy early-morning rain in the Paramillo area, inflows to the Urrá I reservoir were reported rising from 470 to 836 m3/s between 02:00 and 05:00 (about 82%).
